sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Transparent Utah records show Dawna S. Whiting working for American Fork as a victim advocate since at least fiscal year 2014, with records through 2026. The compensation data used here begins in 2014, so the actual start year may have been earlier.
These years are based on reported pay, not exact hire or departure dates. Records through 2026 suggest continued employment, but do not confirm current status.
